layouts.spacing_system: Generous spacing: use p-6 to p-8 for cards, gap-6 to gap-8 for grids.
layouts.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 tight gap (gap-6). High Density Grid for Analytics.
layouts.sidebar: Persistent on desktop (w-64 or w-72). Hidden on mobile (use Shadcn Sheet as hamburger menu).
layouts.card_style: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-[0_4px_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] border border-[#E6E4E0] p-6

motion.hover_state: Slight lift -translate-y-1, shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] transition-all duration-200 ease-out
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for list items using framer-motion.
motion.micro_interactions: Active states must have scale down (scale-95) and subtle color shift.

components.charts: Use Recharts (Shadcn Chart). Ensure colors map to brand palette (Primary Terracotta and Warning Yellow).
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or smooth rounded (rounded-xl). Primary button bg-[#E05D3A] text-white hover:bg-[#C74B2A].
components.inputs: Shadcn input with rounded-xl, bg-white border-[#E6E4E0] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E05D3A]/20 focus:border-[#E05D3A].
components.gauge: For opportunity score, use Recharts radial bar or custom SVG circular progress with #E05D3A.
components.table: Shadcn Table for Client list. Minimal borders, padding-y-4 for breathing room.

responsive.breakpoint: Mobile-first. Use flex-col on mobile, reflowing to flex-row or grid on md and lg.
responsive.layout: Data cards occupy full width on mobile. Side-by-side charts stack vertically.
responsive.typography: Scale down h1 to text-3xl on mobile. Ensure tap targets are minimum 44px (h-11).
responsive.overflow_guard: Ensure tables have overflow-x-auto. Use w-full and max-w-full to prevent horizontal scrolling.
responsive.tap_targets: Interactive elements are comfortable, easily-tappable sizes minimum 44x44px.

images.description: Abstract warm geometric art for empty states or opportunity insight cards

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #E05D3A meets 4.5:1 ratio. Text colors are rich charcoal #1A1A1A (never pure black).
accessibility.focus: All focusable elements must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E05D3A]/50 focus:outline-none.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels for icon-only buttons (like WhatsApp icon button).

instructions_to_main_agent: Language MUST be Bahasa Indonesia for all UI elements (Dasbor, Klien, Tindak Lanjut, Rekomendasi AI, Pesanan, Kalender, Analitik, Pengaturan).
Do NOT use typical Vercel/Stripe 'AI-slop' gradients. Stick to the solid warm palette (Terracotta and Sand) with high quality textures if any.
Do NOT use Inter or Space Grotesk font. Import and use 'Epilogue' for headings and 'DM Sans' for body from Google Fonts.
Build a mobile-first responsive layout. Desktop: fixed sidebar (w-64). Mobile: hide sidebar and use Shadcn Sheet as a hamburger menu.
For the 'Smart Recommendations' section, display cards detailing 'Rekomendasi Penjualan Hari Ini' (What Should I Sell Today?) featuring top clients.
Implement the 'Opportunity Score' (Skor Peluang) as a circular gauge or clear visual indicator on the Client Profile page.
Ensure the AI Message Generator has a Tone Selector (Formal, Santai, Persuasif) and a WhatsApp send button.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
App must feel like a premium CRM for creatives. Utilize generous spacing and avoid clutter. Emphasize the Terracotta (#E05D3A) primary color for distinct CTAs.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Prioritize pre-existing Shadcn components from src/components/ui.
Do not center align the whole App container. Keep text-alignment human-readable (left-aligned mostly).
Apply layered shadows (ambient + direct) for depth, not harsh borders.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💡) as icons. Use Lucide icons instead.
Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or headers over content. Use solid bg or heavy blur + slight tint.
